lines: Get fit. Learn to code. Fix my money.
None of these can be done today.
Why do we stop doing things we know are good for us?
Every morning your brain asks, what do I do about it?
And gets no answer. So it does nothing.
So break it down, until the next step is physical.
Get fit. Run a 5K. Run three times a week. Run Monday at seven. Put your shoes by the door.
If you can't picture your hands doing it, it's still too big.
That's what Dmyor is for. Break your dream into steps you can actually take today.
